title: Willow tree motif
subtitle: A flat applique tree in three shades of green with a brown trunk, 10 cm tall
excerpt: The willow tree works a tapered trunk in brown, then builds three tiers of drooping chain loops upward to form the characteristic weeping silhouette. Worked flat in rows with colour changes at each tier, it reads as a recognisable tree at 10 cm tall and 8 cm wide. Used as an applique on cushions, blankets, and garment panels.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from flat applique tree construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 7 (1892), applied motif chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet willow tree applique motif in three greens and brown, 10 cm tall, photographed flat on natural linen in soft daylight. Three tiers of drooping chain loops visible above a tapered brown trunk.

crochet.finishedSizeText: 10 cm tall; 8 cm wide at widest tier.

chartDefinition.title: Willow tree motif
chartDefinition.caption: Worked flat from base upward. Trunk: 4-row dc rectangle in brown. Three tiers of foliage in descending greens, each tier built from a wider dc base with drooping chain-loop fronds.

glossaryTerms.definition: A separately worked piece sewn onto the surface of a finished base fabric. Willow tree and leaf motifs are typical crochet appliques.

content.text: builds upward from a narrow trunk rectangle, adding three tiers of foliage. Each tier is a wider dc base row with drooping chain-loop fronds hanging from the working edge. The fronds on the lowest tier are longest (6 chains each), giving the weeping silhouette; the upper tier has shorter fronds (4 chains) to narrow the canopy toward the top.

Three shades of green from dark (bottom) to light (top) give the canopy depth. A single green works too but loses the dimensional look. The colour change at each tier requires a fasten-off and re-join rather than a carry, since the trunk colour must be restarted separately.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 3 g of brown DK cotton (trunk), 2 g dark green, 2 g mid green, 2 g light green. A 4 mm crochet hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished willow tree measures 10 cm tall and 8 cm wide in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st) — UK and US shared.
Ch 8. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across to end. (6 dc.) Turn. Ch 1. Dc across. Turn. Repeat once more. (4 rows of 6 dc total.) Fasten off brown.

Join darkest green to the left edge of the top trunk row. Ch 8 (extending the base to the left). Work 18dc across: 6 dc along the ch-8 extension, 6 dc across the trunk top, then 6 dc along a ch-6 extension to the right. Turn. Working along this full 18-dc base: ch 1. *Dc into next dc. Ch 6. Sl st back into the same dc (frond made). Dc into next dc. Dc into next dc.* Repeat from * to * five more times. Fasten off.

Join mid green at 2 dc in from the left edge of the lower tier. Ch 6 (extending left). Work 14dc across including the ch-6 extension and a ch-6 extension on the right. Turn. *Dc into next dc. Ch 5. Sl st back into same dc. Dc into next dc. Dc into next dc.* Repeat from * to * across. Fasten off.

Join light green at 2 dc in from the left edge of the mid tier. Ch 4 (extending left). Work 10dc including extensions on both sides. Turn. *Dc into next dc. Ch 4. Sl st back into same dc. Dc into next dc.* Repeat from * to * across. Fasten off.

definition.title: Willow tree motif
definition.caption: Flat construction. Brown trunk: 4 rows of 6dc. Three foliage tiers worked upward in descending shades, each with drooping chain-loop fronds.

content.text: Weave in all ends. Sew the motif onto a cushion cover, blanket, or garment with a tapestry needle in matching thread, stitching around the trunk perimeter and through each foliage tier base row.
Handwash with the base fabric. The fronds hang naturally when damp and dry without further arranging.

The oak leaf motif (crochet-leaf-oak) uses a similar flat construction in a single colour. For a full woodland scene, combine the willow tree with the hedgehog motif (crochet-animal-hedgehog) and owl motif (crochet-animal-bird) on a blanket panel.
